card.name: Issue number in journal citations
card.fires_on: The issue number, a digit inside parentheses after the volume number in a journal reference, just before a colon and page range. Also seen after 'No.' in a volume citation.

modes.label: Issue in parentheses
modes.description: A single digit in brackets after the volume, followed by a colon and pages.

card.writes: Promotes month names and similar date-like tokens, which fits the volume, issue and date slots of a citation.
card.plain: It marks the issue number in a journal reference, like the 3 in 8(3):175.
